Applications are invited for two Guest faculty (Assistant Professor) in the Centre for Systems
Biology & Bioinformatics, Panjab University, Chandigarh to be filled in through Walk-in-interview,
purely on temporary basis, for the academic session 2024-25.
Desirable
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Good academic record as define by the concerned University with at least 55% of the
marks (50% in case of SC/ST/Physically & Visually handicapped) or an equivalent grade
in a point wherever grading system is followed at Master's degree level i.e. M.Sc. in
Mathematics/Statisties from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an
accredited foreign University.
Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET)conducted by the UGC, CSIR.
Prof. Veena Puri
Chairperson
The candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the
University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D.
Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or
equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
Mobile: 9780283821
Phone:-01 722534603
Ph.D. degree in Mathematics/Statistics with at least two-years of research experience or
teaching experience of post-graduate classes in the field of respective subject with relevant
publication/s in peer reviewed journals.
Vem
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token of honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture
with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to undertake that
he/she will not draw any fellowshipstipend or any financial assistance from any agency and
will do the same till they are teaching in Centre for Systems Biology &Bioinformatics as a
Guest Faculty.
(Prof. Veena Puri)
Applications should reach on or before 07.08.2024 till 4:00. p.m. at csbb2007@pu.ac.in.
Interview will be held on 09.08.2024 at 11.a.m. in the office of the chairperson Centre for
System Biology & Bioinformatics, South Campus Sector-25, Panjab University Chandigarh. No
TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
